subject: english
question:
**Select the appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined word/phrase in the following sentence.**

Grandmother__ revealed the secret.__

options.text: let the chips fall where they may
let the cat out of the bag

solution:
The correct answer is: **let the cat out of the bag**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom "**let the cat out of the bag**" means to reveal a secret or disclose something that was supposed to be kept confidential. (किसी रहस्य को प्रकट करना या किसी ऐसी बात का खुलासा करना जिसे गोपनीय रखा जाना चाहिए)
 
• It suggests that someone has unintentionally or carelessly disclosed information that was meant to be kept hidden.
 
 
• **Example**: *Tom couldn't contain his excitement and accidentally let the cat out of the bag about the surprise vacation.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Let the chance slip by**" means to miss or fail to take advantage of an opportunity. (किसी अवसर का लाभ उठाने में चूक जाना या असफल होना)
 
• "**Let things slide**" means to neglect or ignore something, often allowing it to deteriorate or become less controlled. (किसी चीज़ की उपेक्षा या अनदेखी करना, अक्सर उसे बिगड़ने या कम नियंत्रित होने देना)
 
• "**Let the chips fall where they may**" means to accept the outcome of a situation without trying to control or influence it. (किसी स्थिति को नियंत्रित या प्रभावित करने की कोशिश किए बिना उसके परिणाम को स्वीकार करना)
